categories_thin: Barbers: only four shops turned up across two directories (BestProsInTown and Yellow Pages); East Brunswick barbering appears to be dominated by unlisted single-chair shops and by salons.

Yoga and pilates: still only two yoga/sound studios and one pilates studio found. The rest of the local market is chain studios (Club Pilates, BODYROK, Jersey Strong and big-box gyms), which are excluded.

Dental specialists (periodontics, endodontics, oral surgery): directories mostly surface single listings, often without a street address. Only one periodontist and one oral surgery group could be placed at an address; endodontics produced nothing usable.

Therapists: Psychology Today lists roughly 40 East Brunswick practitioners and paging through it is possible, but most are solo online-only clinicians with no published office address. Nine in-person-capable practices were added or confirmed; a full census would need per-profile lookups.

Primary care and specialists: East Brunswick's physicians are overwhelmingly hospital- or system-employed (Hackensack Meridian, RWJBarnabas, Penn Medicine, Axia, Advocare). Only clearly independent practices are listed.
caveats: Many dental rows still rest on a single Google-derived aggregator (DentistsRanked). Rows whose address could not be confirmed on a practice site, NPI record, insurer directory or WebMD listing keep 'Unknown' and are marked as unaddressed so triage can deprioritise them.

Removed after verification: Brunswick Hills OB/GYN and OB/GYN of East Brunswick (both Axia Women's Health locations; Axia is a multi-state physician group), and 32 Pearls Dentistry (its published address is in North Brunswick, outside this zone).

Borderline entries deliberately retained with a flag: East Brunswick Animal Hospital (privacy policy names National Veterinary Associates), Adult and Pediatric Dermatology/Access Dermatology (appears on a Penn Medicine practices page and is telehealth-only at this address), The Eye Health Group (about eight NJ offices, address also on a Pearle Vision doctor locator), NUVA Smile and Garden State Dental (multi-office brand names), Alliance Orthopedics and Oral Surgery Group (multi-site small groups).

Several practices share buildings or suites and may be the same business under two names: TKI The Dental Suite / TKI The Kaga Institute (555 Route 18); Kendall Road Family Dentistry / Dr. Anthony Matrone (704 Route 18); Dental Group of East Brunswick / Brunswick Dental Group; Village Dental Associates / Brunswick Dental Group (415 Route 18); Total Rehabilitation / NJ Health and Performance Institute (317 Rues Lane); Dr. Alan Wolkoff / Corrective Care Group / Saumin Patel PT (67 West Prospect Street).
Dr. Gina Tanios-Rafla's office at 646 Route 18 Suite 114 now appears to trade under Dr. Ehab Aziz per the practice website; ownership change unconfirmed.

Flagged as chains/franchises and excluded: Aspen Dental, Supercuts, JCPenney Salon, Massage Envy, Hand & Stone, HairClub, Tiger Schulmann's, Banfield, VCA Edgebrook, Club Pilates, BODYROK, Crunch, LA Fitness, Planet Fitness, Jersey Strong, Trinity Rehab, JAG Physical Therapy, Kessler Rehabilitation, Hackensack Meridian Rehabilitation, Children's Specialized Hospital, and the Eyexam Group inside LensCrafters.
Several Route 18 entries are suites inside large strip centres (Midstate Mall, Lexington Downs, 300/415/444/646/647 Route 18); suite numbers are as published by directories.
Gym directory entries at residential-style addresses (Semper Fit Me, Dig Your Deepest Fitness) are kept but flagged low-confidence.
data_gaps: Overpass/OSM API returned 502 and was not usable for a bulk business census.
Google Maps shows only a limited result view without sign-in (about four visible results per query), so it could not serve as a bulk census.

Yellow Pages, Superpages, Cylex, ChamberofCommerce.com and Manta blocked automated fetches with 403/Cloudflare responses; Yellow Pages barber and acupuncture pages were only readable through search snippets.

DentistsRanked clinic detail pages rate-limited (HTTP 429) earlier in the research, and its ranked list page does not expose street addresses, so per-clinic addresses had to be sourced elsewhere or left Unknown.
East Brunswick Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory is JavaScript-loaded and could not be read; the Township site has no public business-licence directory.

One entry from the earlier version was dropped because no source could be re-confirmed: Dr. Gerald Mitchell Emergency Dentist (a single aggregator line; a dentist by that name could not be located in East Brunswick).
Penn Medicine's practices page for Access Dermatology would not render for fetching, so the affiliation question for Dr. Shraga's practice is unresolved.
